status: post-opening held-out metacommunity hypothesis frozen before validation readback
ecological_question: Does pre-existing among-stop compositional heterogeneity determine how strongly a later rainfall contrast expands route-level active richness?

baseline_template.per_run_beta: normalized Whittaker beta among acoustically active stops: ((gamma/alpha_active)-1)/(n_active-1), requiring >=2 active stops
baseline_template.baseline_beta: mean per-run normalized Whittaker beta across baseline years

validation_pairs.construction: within 2008-2015 only, same adjacent-observed-year matched wetter-drier rule as the ecological pulse analysis

primary_model.formula: richness_gain ~ rain_contrast * z_baseline_beta + rain_contrast * z_baseline_gamma + rain_contrast * z_baseline_active_stops + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber)
primary_model.interpretation: Higher pre-existing spatial differentiation exposes more distinct latent active-species pools as rainfall conditions change.

mechanistic_secondary.response: corner expansion: net route-new species x newly active stop incidences
mechanistic_secondary.formula: corner_expansion ~ rain_contrast * z_baseline_beta + rain_contrast * z_baseline_gamma + rain_contrast * z_baseline_active_stops + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber)
mechanistic_secondary.status: secondary mechanism test fixed before readback

boundaries: Baseline beta diversity is acoustic compositional differentiation, not measured habitat heterogeneity.
The test does not demonstrate dispersal, source-sink dynamics, or spatial insurance in the demographic sense.
A positive interaction would support latent spatial community heterogeneity as a moderator of active gamma expansion, not rainfall causality.
No alternative time split, beta metric, minimum-run gate, or moderator model may replace the frozen specification after readback.
